summary: Perceptive Capital Solutions Corp (PCSC) filed an 8-K postponing its extraordinary general meeting (EGM) for shareholder approval of its business combination with Freenome Holdings, Inc. from July 9 to July 15, 2026, to supplement disclosure and solicit proxies. No price per share or premium was stated; the SPAC merger continues to be voted on. The deadline for redemption demands is extended to July 13, 2026. This SPAC de-SPAC postponement reflects typical procedural delays. Watch for updated proxy disclosures and whether redemptions increase ahead of the new deadline, which could affect deal cash available.
